messages:
zoe: sprint-0 decision thread: lock what we ship for the visibility console. scope proposals: cost-by-route (estimates ok), error groups, trace pointers, and a tiny alerts list.
mark: +1. need clear launch gates and who owns what. big trade: precise billing vs friction for SDKs.
anya: UX: show a single overview with panels for Top Routes, Cost (estimate badge if heuristic), Errors (groups), and Traces (quick-links). keep advanced filters for phase 2.
leo: runtime: sampling defaults matter. propose 0.25% baseline, trace-on-error for 5xx/timeouts, and an on-demand capture endpoint. expose feature.flag for per-customer sampling override.
felix: infra: accurate per-route billing requires `x-route-id` header. if not present, we'll use path+model heuristics. retention: 48h raw traces + 30d rollups approx +9% infra delta. need finance OK.
zoe: draft launch gates: dashboards render <2s P95; ingestion lag <6m P95; overview shows top-10 routes; error grouping with fingerprints; trace quick-links present; cost estimates labelled with confidence band; docs + pilot validation.
mark: decision: ship heuristics day 0, provide header migration docs and an opt-in for precise accounting later. thumbs?
anya: thumbs up. I'll add an "estimated" badge + a confidence meter UI by Tue.
leo: will implement sampling flags + trace capture API. ETA Mon.
felix: will run canary for ingestion pipeline and provide cost delta numbers for finance. canary scheduled: visibility-canary -> 2145678960.
billing-bot: note: customers enabling precise route headers will be billed starting next invoice cycle.
zoe: action items summarized: mark (canary + perf), anya (UX mocks + badges), leo (tracing flags + capture API), felix (retention/cost estimate), zoe (launch checklist + finance loop). reconvene after canary metrics. :white_check_mark:
